name: Individual
benefits:
Member rate at every workshop and the annual conference
The Commonground quarterly in print and online
Full access to the member resource library
A vote in board elections
Member pricing at the seed exchange

name: Household
audience: Up to four people at one address
benefits:
Everything in Individual, for up to four people
Two conference passes at the member rate
Family workshop days twice a year
A welcome kit with heirloom seed packets

name: Garden Group
audience: Community gardens, school gardens and allotment societies
benefits:
Up to 25 named members on one account
$1M general liability cover for group events
A listing on the chapter directory map
Eligibility for Commonground seed grants
One free site visit from a regional mentor

name: Supporter
audience: Neighbours and businesses who want to give more
benefits:
Everything in Household
Your name in the annual report (if you like)
An invitation to the autumn harvest dinner
Half of your dues fund new gardens in food deserts
